{"answer":"WITH active_task_counts AS (
  SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS active_task_count
  FROM tasks
  WHERE archived = 0
  GROUP BY project_id
),
ranked_attempts AS (
  SELECT t.project_id, a.task_id, a.status,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a.task_id
           ORDER BY a.finished_at DESC, a.id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM tasks AS t
  JOIN attempts AS a ON a.task_id = t.id
  WHERE t.archived = 0
),
successful_latest AS (
  SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS successful_latest_count
  FROM ranked_attempts
  WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'success'
  GROUP BY project_id
)
SELECT p.id AS project_id,
       COALESCE(atc.active_task_count, 0) AS active_task_count,
       COALESCE(sl.successful_latest_count, 0) AS successful_latest_count
FROM projects AS p
LEFT JOIN active_task_counts AS atc ON atc.project_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN successful_latest AS sl ON sl.project_id = p.id
